review_scope: Completed Ouro and Huginn measurements. Dory is deferred by the user. This is a closed PoC, not a deployment qualification.

overall.reason: Huginn has a bounded strict-ITL goodput signal. General E2E improvement, original-reference fidelity, sustainable capacity, and loop-specific novelty are not established.

ouro.reason: A loses to the strongest measured equal-GPU DP/Mixed controls in all four repeated two-GPU regimes. This finding does not exclude untested long-context or other PD implementations.

scale_notes.2: Three frozen starts per regime, exact bounded outputs. No accepted equal-budget benefit.
scale_notes.4: One-start candidate discovery. No accepted gain. Natural pressure also changes outputs.
scale_notes.8: Best synthetic candidate is 1.066x in one start, below the target. No gain CI.

huginn.reason: At P512/C4, a frozen absolute-150ms ITL cell improves bounded goodput. The strongest E2E baseline is still faster. Multiple SLO cells, three starts, unresolved reference fidelity, and generic migration limit the claim.

scale_notes.2: Strict-ITL goodput signal only. No deployment or general E2E GO.
scale_notes.4: One-start candidate discovery does not beat the strongest baseline. No gain CI.
scale_notes.8: One-start synthetic gains are below the target. Pressure comparisons change outputs.

overall.reason: Immutable-frontier transfer is internally correct. Narrow two-GPU signals remain. Generic layerwise streaming, reference fidelity, three-start uncertainty, and incomplete capacity tests prevent GO.

ouro.reason: P512/C4 gives 1.090x p95 E2E versus DP Mixed, with a 1.012-1.153x conditional CI. Moderate-SLO goodput is only 1.034x. Other repeated regimes lose. No general loop-specific GO.

scale_notes.2: A narrow 8.3% latency reduction is below the 10% target and does not generalize.
scale_notes.4: One-start synthetic and pressure discovery do not establish a benefit.
scale_notes.8: The apparent pressure gain is one-start and output-confounded. Synthetic B loses.

huginn.reason: At P512/C4 and absolute ITL 150ms, bounded goodput improves versus the best measured control. E2E remains worse than DP/Mixed. Official-reference mismatch and generic streaming controls remain unresolved.

scale_notes.2: Frozen-grid goodput signal, not sustainable serving capacity or an original-model fidelity GO.
scale_notes.4: One-start discovery lacks a gain against the strongest baseline.
scale_notes.8: One-start discovery lacks a gain. Pressure output parity is incomplete.

overall.reason: Natural batched placement changes output sequences. The repeated service-time ablation also lacks a demonstrated incremental gain. No lossless scheduling speedup is accepted.

ouro.reason: Loop versus service-time placement matches 125/144 outputs and gives 0.981x p95 E2E. A one-start synthetic four-GPU signal does not repair the natural-output gate or prove loop-specific novelty.

scale_notes.2: A fixed 1P:1D pool has no initial placement choice. No independent C gain is measured.
scale_notes.4: Repeated natural output parity fails. A single synthetic signal remains unconfirmed.
scale_notes.8: Synthetic loop versus service is 1.001x in one start. Natural-pressure parity fails.

huginn.reason: Loop versus service-time placement matches 139/144 outputs and gives 1.016x p95 E2E with a 0.977-1.093x conditional CI. No lossless incremental gain is established.

scale_notes.2: A fixed 1P:1D pool has no initial placement choice. No independent C gain is measured.
scale_notes.4: Repeated natural output parity fails. Strong static controls remain faster.
scale_notes.8: One-start synthetic loop placement loses to service-time placement. Natural-pressure parity fails.
